name: browser_fill
description: Navigate to a URL, fill in form fields, optionally submit the form, and return the resulting page state.

url.description: The full URL to navigate to (include https://)

fields.description: List of form fields to fill

selector.description: CSS selector for the input field

value.description: Value to fill into the field

submit_selector.description: Optional CSS selector for the submit button to click after filling fields
